title: Crestline Summit Loyalty Program Terms: Closing a Membership
content:
**Who closes.** Only the member can close a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program membership, by confirming the closure personally.

**What is lost.** Closing forfeits the entire mile balance, with account closure as the ground, and all unused upgrade certificates and unmade choice selections lapse. None of these can ever be reinstated.

**When closure is not possible.** A membership cannot be closed while it has an open waitlisted upgrade or an unflown award ticket issued from it; those must be cancelled first. The membership's upgrade requests and award tickets on record are what decide.

**Other products.** Companion certificates and passes are revoked with their remaining trips under the Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes charter. A club membership issued as a choice benefit runs to its renewal date and is not renewed as a benefit. Credits or tickets in the customer's name are unaffected.

| On record at the time of the request | Closure |
|---|---|
| No open waitlisted upgrade and no unflown award ticket | Possible once the member confirms personally |
| An open waitlisted upgrade | Not possible while it stands |
| An unflown award ticket issued from the membership | Not possible while it stands |
